append.detail: Closed by SEC-010 (#3932). Daniel approved replacing this row's probe (2026-10-26, 'Two security rows whose checks look for old code: A'). The original ssrf-og probe matched one implementation (remote-logo, isPrivateIp or assertPublic in remote-image.ts); the repair is the shared lib/net/pinned-fetch.ts, so the probe is now scripts/probes/sec-ssrf-pinned-fetch.mjs, which asserts all three call sites.
